notes.notes:
The  current  virsion has been basically improved, it not like appear some strange bugs.but a little people said there are some strange bug that dialog box cannot be shut down, but it is not the problem of the game itself, so I can only suggest that who meet these bugs restart or reinstall the game. %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/JuMeowMeow/A Day For A Kitten

notes.title: Fixed choose language,etc.
notes.notes:
This revision is mainly fixed the choice of language and repair the bug of the treasure box.
New players can ignore the following:
Due to the limited technology, the old player's save data needs to copy the following address to the local window address bar and find FileName.txt,
copy address:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/JuMeowMeow/A Day For A Kitten

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31156693/34b13c5f21cd7488c7708a6932b726355ab07234.png[/img]
add 0 (or 1) to the last row and save it (0 is Chinese, 1 is English). 
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31156693/0c511e3739b56b1cd867dfc5c96392ad70cb13bb.png[/img]
When you add it, you don't need to control him again.
Thank you very much.

notes.title: Fix bag items' numbers,etc.
notes.notes:
1. Clearly display  items' numbers.

Next, it is expected to modify animation, interactive, and language selection.
I believe that the playability has been greatly enhanced, and we hope to get more evaluation.

notes.title: Modified bug, such as interaction and UI
notes.notes:
I think I may have been alone doing this for a long time. I have seen everyone's evaluationso that I know that there is a problem in my own practice, and I will change it a little bit.
This revision:
1.Fixed part of the collision and fall of.
2.Interaction does not move when it is animated.
3.Interactive time mouse icon is changed into an exclamation mark.
4.esc changes to the cleaning window.
5.working interface became obvious to accept or cancel.
6.strengthen the bouncing.
Look forward to more evaluation!
